title: TAB Racing Day Scene Plan

headlineCategory.description: Fresh Kubrick V2 LLM copy generation emits this for every Scene 8. It remains schema-optional only for compatibility with previously stored plans. Category meaning, eligibility and diversity policy are owned by scene-contracts.json and never affect deterministic Scene 8 grouping.

semanticValidation: Deterministic planner code is the sole authority for scene structure. LLM copy merge may add only approved LLM-owned fields to the matching deterministic scenes and may not add, remove, duplicate, reorder, regroup or alter structural fields.
Scene 1 first exactly once; Scene 6 second-last exactly once; Scene 7 last exactly once.

Scene 4 at most once; when present deterministic planner code places it at the actual Scene 2/5/8 primary boundary minimizing abs(completed/totalBets - 0.5), earlier tie, and owns checkpointAfterBetSequence. If the boundary ends in Scene 2 with attached Scene 3, Scene 4 follows that replay. Never split Scene 8 for midpoint.
Every input bet sequence appears exactly once as primary coverage in Scene 2, Scene 5 or Scene 8; Scene 3 never counts.
Primary coverage is ascending with no gaps, duplicates or reordering.
Scene 5 contains exactly 2 or 3 consecutive ascending sequences.

Scene 8 contains exactly 4 or 5 consecutive ascending sequences and comments.length must equal betSequences.length. Fresh LLM copy generation emits headlineCategory; the field remains schema-optional only for compatibility with previously stored plans. Category meaning, eligibility and diversity policy are owned by scene-contracts.json.

Scene 8 pre-result headlines are deterministically rejected when code can mechanically prove an obvious grouped-result leak, including explicit outcome language, outcome-derived money values that are not valid pre-result facts, and explicit grouped finishing-position disclosure. Subtle semantic spoilers remain prompt and live-inspection responsibilities.
Scene 3 immediately follows Scene 2 for the same sequence and requires WIN plus a valid non-empty HTTPS replayUrl in bettings.json; Scene 3 may not attach to Scene 5 or Scene 8.
Final scene-plan contains only structural planner fields plus contract-declared LLM-owned fields. FACT, builder-DERIVED, CONTROLLED and RUNTIME display fields remain outside scene-plan.json.
Planner and builder treat maxWords/itemMaxWords/maxChars/itemMaxChars as copy and design targets only; prose length is not storage-fatal.

Planner and builder deterministically calculate user-visible planned duration from runtime-contract.json. Planned duration must not exceed the hard maximum; replay metadata/play timeout allowances are runtime failure-safety behaviour, not editorial duration.
Scene 8 headlineCategory meaning, eligibility and diversity are copy-stage quality rules and never authorize structural changes.
Natural-language quality and any no-spoiler meaning beyond the mechanically provable Scene 8 guard remain copy-prompt responsibilities.
